annotations.title: Search the foodose GLP-1 recipe library

description: Published GLP-1 recipes with per serving calories and protein, every ingredient traceable to a USDA FoodData Central record. Useful when someone asks what to actually eat, rather than what their targets are. The Foodose iPhone app plans whole days from a dish library of its own, around the user's dose week.

query.description: Matches title, cuisine, main ingredient and ingredient names.
